objective: Make pi install of a HolyAgent release tag work in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-pi (branch release/0.3.0/feat/pi-package, head 4bbaa16) by fixing the three install blockers and adding the pi output to CI's stale-build check.
scope: Run every command in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-pi. The earlier report: .git/holyagent/reports/assignment-0mw77lh0d-07e5.md (questions 1-5) gives the evidence and pi source lines (dist/core/package-manager.js L1566-1578, L1633-1660; utils/git.js splitRef; packages.md L13, L56-L75) in /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-probe/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent.

1. workspace protocol: pi runs npm install --omit=dev --legacy-peer-deps at the clone root (or its configured npmCommand; HolyAgent's pi setup will set it to bun). Evidence: re-run the consumer-install simulation on a git archive of the final tree with both npm install --omit=dev --legacy-peer-deps and bun install --production (or the bun equivalent pi would run), each exiting 0, and show that a normal bun install --frozen-lockfile in the worktree still runs the hooks setup.
